notes: All lyrics are original. Prompts do not request imitation of living artists.
timesignature is the CoT YAML string '4' (numerator), matching acestep.cpp field convention rather than a '4/4' display string.
Every prompt supplies caption, lyrics, duration, bpm, keyscale, timesignature, language, and seed so both engines skip Phase-1 lyric generation.
